# Resource: stripe_payment_method_domain

A domain on which payment methods such as Apple Pay and Google Pay are offered. `terraform destroy` disables the domain, because Stripe cannot delete one; the domain stays in the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "stripe_payment_method_domain" "checkout" {
  domain_name = "pay.example.com"
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are required:

* `domain_name` - (Required) The domain name that this payment method domain object represents. Changing it replaces the resource.

The following arguments are optional:

* `enabled` - (Optional) Whether this payment method domain is enabled. If the domain is not enabled, payment methods that require a payment method domain will not appear in Elements or Embedded Checkout. Removing it from the configuration stops sending it, and the next apply records the value Stripe holds.

## Attribute Reference

This resource exports the following attributes in addition to the arguments above:

* `id` - Unique identifier for the object.
* `amazon_pay` - Indicates the status of a specific payment method on a payment method domain. See [`amazon_pay`](#amazon_pay) below.
* `apple_pay` - Indicates the status of a specific payment method on a payment method domain. See [`apple_pay`](#apple_pay) below.
* `created` - Time at which the object was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.
* `google_pay` - Indicates the status of a specific payment method on a payment method domain. See [`google_pay`](#google_pay) below.
* `klarna` - Indicates the status of a specific payment method on a payment method domain. See [`klarna`](#klarna) below.
* `link` - Indicates the status of a specific payment method on a payment method domain. See [`link`](#link) below.
* `livemode` - If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.
* `paypal` - Indicates the status of a specific payment method on a payment method domain. See [`paypal`](#paypal) below.

## Timeouts

[Configuration options](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/syntax#operation-timeouts) are set with the `timeouts` attribute, for example `timeouts = { create = "5m" }`:

* `create` - (Default `20m`)
* `delete` - (Default `20m`)
* `update` - (Default `20m`)

## Import

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, and in OpenTofu, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import a payment method domain using its ID. For example:

```terraform
import {
  to = stripe_payment_method_domain.checkout
  id = "pmd_123"
}
```

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, and in OpenTofu v1.12.0 and later, the `import` block can use the `identity` attribute instead. For example:

```terraform
import {
  to = stripe_payment_method_domain.checkout
  identity = {
    id = "pmd_123"
  }
}
```

### Identity Schema

#### Required

* `id` (String) The Stripe ID of the payment method domain.

Using `terraform import`, import a payment method domain using its ID. For example:

```console
% terraform import stripe_payment_method_domain.checkout pmd_123
```
